A '''Nazzar''' [[Gender/Legends|male]] served as an [[Icecrawler/Legends|icecrawler]] driver on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Syned]] for the [[Arkadianate]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]]. He was transporting a crawlerful of refugees from [[Diligence (New Sith Wars)|''Diligence'']], a [[Starship/Legends|starship]], to the [[City/Legends|capital city]] of [[Calimondretta]] when the captain of the ship, [[Jarrow Rusher]], led a mutiny to steal the vehicle in preparation for an [[Siege of Calimondretta|siege]] of Calimondretta. During a scuffle, Rusher killed the Nazzar by breaking his neck. Meanwhile, the other Arkadianate crew were killed by members of [[Team Ripper]], led by [[Zeller]].
